_note: Which official data point(s) of the DG GROW battery-passport guidance (battery-datapoints-v3.2.json) each battery.json field carries. Audit check [21] reads it: a field required for a category must carry a data point that is mandatory there; a conditional one, a data point that is mandatory or applies in certain cases. Only fields that can block publishing (required or conditional in some category) need an entry.
